title: P3 skill_read: arguments
description: Reads one file of a skill of the role from the core copy (SKL-4). P3 closes name and file by enum lists of the role skills and of their files in tools/list.

name.description: Skill name; tools/list closes it by an enum of the role skills.
name.x-botaru-closed-by: enum of the role skills in tools/list

file.description: File path inside the skill directory; tools/list closes it by an enum of the skill files.
file.x-botaru-closed-by: enum of the skill files in tools/list

offset.description: Byte offset of a file longer than one answer; 0 by default.
